title: Passive Voice (Present)
summary: Talking about processes, services, and what is done in a place or context.
whyItMatters: The present passive focuses on an action or process when the actor is unknown, obvious, or less important.

mentalModel.title: Move the object into focus
mentalModel.content: The active accusative object becomes the passive subject.

mentalModel.title: Build werden plus participle
mentalModel.content: Conjugate werden in the present and place the past participle at the end.

ruleBlocks.title: Form the present passive
ruleBlocks.content: Use wird/werden plus Partizip II: Das Brot wird gebacken.

ruleBlocks.title: Add the actor only when useful
ruleBlocks.content: Use von plus dative for a person or organization and durch for a means or process.

ruleBlocks.title: Choose passive for process focus
ruleBlocks.content: Use active when the responsible person is central and passive when the action or result is central.

tables.title: Active to Passive
rows: Der Laden wird von der Familie geführt.

examples.de: Die Bestellungen werden jeden Morgen vorbereitet.
examples.en: The orders are prepared every morning.

examples.de: Das Geschäft wird von zwei Schwestern geführt.
examples.en: The shop is run by two sisters.

examples.de: Die Waren werden online und im Laden verkauft.
examples.en: The goods are sold online and in the shop.

commonMistakes.wrong: Das Brot ist gebacken every day.
commonMistakes.correct: Das Brot wird jeden Tag gebacken.
commonMistakes.reason: Werden describes the process; sein describes a resulting state.
The passive requires the past participle.

comparisons.summary: Shops and family businesses provide authentic process descriptions.
Active and passive choices clarify people, milestones, and processes.
